integrity: Analytic proof with finite exact-rational and exhaustive small-instance checks; no finite check is used to prove an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Exact asymptotic excess and boundary-depth minimization only; does not rank all finite trees or settle the finite-length attachment-depth minimizer. Historical priority is qualified, and no independent external audit has been undertaken.
title: Boundary-to-bulk branch response in random greedy adsorption on paths
